1: # The Game module contains methods for saving and loading the game.
2: module Game
3:   # Initializes various global variables and loads the game data.
4:   def self.initialize
5:     $game_temp          = Game_Temp.new
6:     $game_system        = Game_System.new
7:     $data_animations    = load_data("Data/Animations.rxdata")
8:     $data_tilesets      = load_data("Data/Tilesets.rxdata")
9:     $data_common_events = load_data("Data/CommonEvents.rxdata")
10:     $data_system        = load_data("Data/System.rxdata")
11:     pbLoadBattleAnimations
12:     GameData.load_all
13:     map_file = sprintf("Data/Map%03d.rxdata", $data_system.start_map_id)
14:     if $data_system.start_map_id == 0 || !pbRgssExists?(map_file)
15:       raise _INTL("No starting position was set in the map editor.")
16:     end
17:   end
18: 
19:   # Loads bootup data from save file (if it exists) or creates bootup data (if
20:   # it doesn't).
21:   def self.set_up_system
22:     save_data = (SaveData.exists?) ? SaveData.read_from_file(SaveData::FILE_PATH) : {}
23:     if save_data.empty?
24:       SaveData.initialize_bootup_values
25:     else
26:       SaveData.load_bootup_values(save_data)
27:     end
28:     # Set resize factor
29:     pbSetResizeFactor([$PokemonSystem.screensize, 4].min)
30:     # Set language (and choose language if there is no save file)
31:     if !Settings::LANGUAGES.empty?
32:       $PokemonSystem.language = pbChooseLanguage if save_data.empty? && Settings::LANGUAGES.length >= 2
33:       MessageTypes.load_message_files(Settings::LANGUAGES[$PokemonSystem.language][1])
34:     end
35:   end
36: 
37:   # Called when starting a new game. Initializes global variables
38:   # and transfers the player into the map scene.
39:   def self.start_new
40:     if $game_map&.events
41:       $game_map.events.each_value { |event| event.clear_starting }
42:     end
43:     $game_temp.common_event_id = 0 if $game_temp
44:     $game_temp.begun_new_game = true
45:     pbMapInterpreter&.clear
46:     pbMapInterpreter&.setup(nil, 0, 0)
47:     $scene = Scene_Map.new
48:     SaveData.load_new_game_values
49:     $game_temp.last_uptime_refreshed_play_time = System.uptime
50:     $stats.play_sessions += 1
51:     $map_factory = PokemonMapFactory.new($data_system.start_map_id)
52:     $game_player.moveto($data_system.start_x, $data_system.start_y)
53:     $game_player.refresh
54:     $PokemonEncounters = PokemonEncounters.new
55:     $PokemonEncounters.setup($game_map.map_id)
56:     $game_map.autoplay
57:     $game_map.update
58:   end
59: 
60:   # Loads the game from the given save data and starts the map scene.
61:   # @param save_data [Hash] hash containing the save data
62:   # @raise [SaveData::InvalidValueError] if an invalid value is being loaded
63:   def self.load(save_data)
64:     validate save_data => Hash
65:     SaveData.load_all_values(save_data)
66:     $game_temp.last_uptime_refreshed_play_time = System.uptime
67:     $stats.play_sessions += 1
68:     self.load_map
69:     pbAutoplayOnSave
70:     $game_map.update
71:     $PokemonMap.updateMap
72:     $scene = Scene_Map.new
73:   end
74: 
75:   # Loads and validates the map. Called when loading a saved game.
76:   def self.load_map
77:     $game_map = $map_factory.map
78:     magic_number_matches = ($game_system.magic_number == $data_system.magic_number)
79:     if !magic_number_matches || $PokemonGlobal.safesave
80:       pbMapInterpreter.setup(nil, 0) if pbMapInterpreterRunning?
81:       begin
82:         $map_factory.setup($game_map.map_id)
83:       rescue Errno::ENOENT
84:         if $DEBUG
85:           pbMessage(_INTL("Map {1} was not found.", $game_map.map_id))
86:           map = pbWarpToMap
87:           exit unless map
88:           $map_factory.setup(map[0])
89:           $game_player.moveto(map[1], map[2])
90:         else
91:           raise _INTL("The map was not found. The game cannot continue.")
92:         end
93:       end
94:       $game_player.center($game_player.x, $game_player.y)
95:     else
96:       $map_factory.setMapChanged($game_map.map_id)
97:     end
98:     if $game_map.events.nil?
99:       raise _INTL("The map is corrupt. The game cannot continue.")
100:     end
101:     $PokemonEncounters = PokemonEncounters.new
102:     $PokemonEncounters.setup($game_map.map_id)
103:     pbUpdateVehicle
104:   end
105: 
106:   # Saves the game. Returns whether the operation was successful.
107:   # @param save_file [String] the save file path
108:   # @param safe [Boolean] whether $PokemonGlobal.safesave should be set to true
109:   # @return [Boolean] whether the operation was successful
110:   # @raise [SaveData::InvalidValueError] if an invalid value is being saved
111:   def self.save(save_file = SaveData::FILE_PATH, safe: false)
112:     validate save_file => String, safe => [TrueClass, FalseClass]
113:     $PokemonGlobal.safesave = safe
114:     $game_system.save_count += 1
115:     $game_system.magic_number = $data_system.magic_number
116:     $stats.set_time_last_saved
117:     begin
118:       SaveData.save_to_file(save_file)
119:       Graphics.frame_reset
120:     rescue IOError, SystemCallError
121:       $game_system.save_count -= 1
122:       return false
123:     end
124:     return true
125:   end
126: end
